models.name: Nemotron-Labs Dory 4B
models.full_name: Nemotron-Labs Dory 4B (looped architecture, last_loop KV cache)

engines.quant: Dory 1.0 4B, 256K context, Flash Attention, single llama-server slot, Dory overrides for two loops and last-loop KV-cache mode; needs llama.cpp#30306 (not yet upstream)

models.why: NVIDIA's Dory 1.0 4B holds a 262,144-token context resident on a 12GB RTX 3060 with 16GB system RAM at ~50 tok/s decode, its looped architecture and last_loop KV-cache mode keeping the cache at about one loop's size instead of pushing it into system RAM.

models.name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B-Distill (Empero, community distillation into Qwen3.6-35B-A3B MoE)

engines.quant: Q4_K_M, 26 MoE layers on CPU, Flash Attention, Q8 KV cache

models.why: Empero's 35B-A3B distillation runs at ~50 tok/s on a single 12GB RTX 3060 by pushing 26 MoE layers onto the CPU with Q4_K_M, keeping a 262K context and ~550 tok/s prefill on hardware that would normally need 20GB+ for this model class.

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B

engines.quant: PrismML Bonsai 2 27B ternary (~1.72 bits/weight), PQ2_0 build; needs the PrismML llama.cpp fork because the kernels are not upstream

models.why: The PrismML ternary Bonsai 2 pack of Qwen3.8-27B runs a 220K context on a 12GB RTX 3060 at ~35 tok/s decode and ~550 tok/s prefill with a 7.21GB PQ2_0 file — only possible on the PrismML llama.cpp fork, since stock llama.cpp rejects the ternary files.
